language_gaps.text: Update request data annotations are not invoked by the minimal API endpoint; they are not modeled as guarantees
The API and Admin page update different fields, so their behaviors are modeled separately
The Admin page also depends on view-model annotations that were not inspected in detail

properties.text: a non-administrator cannot change a catalog item
updating a missing item does not create it
a non-positive price leaves the existing item unchanged
a zero brand or type prevents the API update from being persisted
valid API input updates details, brand, and type
the Admin page preserves the existing description, brand, and type
a non-administrator cannot change an item through the Admin page
an item whose existing description is empty is not edited from the Admin page
only an authenticated administrator receives catalog-management access
a missing identity or administrator role grants no access
valid name, description, and price replace the item's details
a zero or negative price leaves the item unchanged
an empty name leaves the item unchanged
an empty description leaves the item unchanged
updating details does not change the brand, type, or image
a zero brand identifier is rejected
a zero type identifier is rejected
